description: This source file implements HTTP Range request handling according to RFC 7233 for the lighttpd server. It contains functions for parsing Range headers, coalescing overlapping ranges, and generating responses for single or multiple byte ranges, including support for partial content responses (206). It references external modules like buffer, chunk, http_header, http_status, and request to manipulate data buffers, chunk queues, headers, HTTP statuses, and request data.

methods.name: void http_range_config_allow_http10(int flag)
methods.description: Sets the flag to allow or ignore Range requests in HTTP/1.0 requests.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int http_range_coalesce_unsorted(off_t * const restrict ranges,int n)
methods.description: Coalesces overlapping or closely separated ranges into merged ranges.

methods.name: const char * http_range_parse_next(const char * restrict s,const off_t len,off_t * const restrict ranges)
methods.description: Parses the next range specification from the Range header string.

methods.name: int http_range_parse(const char * restrict s,const off_t content_length,off_t ranges[RMAX * 2])
methods.description: Parses the entire Range header value into an array of ranges, handling overlapping and unsorted ranges.

methods.name: void http_range_single(request_st * const r,const off_t ranges[2])
methods.description: Prepares a single range response, modifying the request's chunkqueue accordingly.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void http_range_multi(request_st * const r,const off_t ranges[RMAX * 2],const int n)
methods.description: Prepares a multipart/byteranges response with multiple ranges.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int http_range_not_satisfiable(request_st * const r,const off_t content_length)
methods.description: Generates a 416 Range Not Satisfiable response.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int http_range_process(request_st * const r,const buffer * const http_range)
methods.description: Processes the Range header, handling validation and delegating to single or multiple range responses.

methods.name: int http_range_rfc7233(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Main entry point for handling Range requests according to RFC 7233 within a request cycle.
